desktop.notes:
• A start screen while Cullect loads: one of five wildlife photos (lion, zebra, wildebeest, hippo), shown whole, with the version, your Keep / Discard totals and a bar that follows the real loading. It fades in and out.
• Cullect opens where you left it - same monitor, size and maximized or not - and the start screen appears on that monitor too (first time: the monitor under the mouse).
• Your own photos or words: put .jpg files in a splash folder inside Cullect-data (next to Cullect.exe), optionally with a splash.json (tagline, on/off).
